name: Ergo 3.0x Loupe System

name: Ergo 4.0x Loupe System

data.secondary: Available in multiple frame styles including Blues, Soul, and Indie. The increased magnification provides excellent detail while maintaining a comfortable field of view.

name: Ergo 5.0x Loupe System
description: High-magnification ergonomic loupe for precision dental and surgical work

data.primary: The Ergo 5.0x delivers exceptional magnification for demanding procedures requiring superior detail. Perfect for microsurgery, complex endodontics, and precision restorations.
data.secondary: Available in multiple frame styles including Blues, Jazz, and Soul. The 5.0x magnification provides outstanding visual clarity while the ergonomic design ensures comfort during extended procedures.

name: Ergo 6.0x Loupe System
description: Professional-grade 6.0x magnification for advanced clinical procedures

data.primary: The Ergo 6.0x provides professional-grade magnification for specialists requiring exceptional detail visualization. Ideal for periodontal surgery, implantology, and complex restorative procedures.
data.secondary: Available in multiple premium frame styles. The advanced optics deliver crystal-clear images while maintaining a usable field of view and depth of field.

name: Ergo 7.5x Loupe System
description: High-performance 7.5x magnification for microsurgical procedures

data.primary: The Ergo 7.5x delivers high-performance magnification approaching microscope levels while maintaining the freedom of movement that loupes provide.
data.secondary: Designed for specialists in endodontics, periodontal microsurgery, and other disciplines requiring exceptional visual detail. Available in premium frame styles.

name: Ergo 10x Loupe System
description: Maximum magnification loupe system for the most demanding microsurgical applications

data.primary: The Ergo 10x represents the pinnacle of loupe magnification technology. Provides microscope-level detail while maintaining the ergonomic benefits and freedom of movement that loupes offer.
data.secondary: Designed for the most demanding applications in endodontic microsurgery, periodontal surgery, and specialized dental procedures. Available in premium frame styles.

name: Ergo V Loupe System
description: Next-generation ergonomic design with adjustable declination for optimal posture

data.primary: The Ergo V features Admetec's revolutionary adjustable declination system, allowing you to customize the viewing angle from 0° to 45° for optimal ergonomic posture.
data.secondary: Available in multiple magnification levels. The Ergo V significantly reduces neck and back strain during extended procedures while maintaining exceptional optical clarity.

name: Ergo V Pro Loupe System
description: Premium version with integrated LED lighting and enhanced ergonomics

data.primary: The Ergo V Pro combines the revolutionary ergonomic design of the Ergo V with an integrated high-performance LED lighting system for complete visual enhancement.
data.secondary: Features adjustable declination, premium titanium frame, and wireless LED headlight delivering 55,000 lux. The complete solution for demanding clinical environments.

name: Galilean 2.5x Loupe
description: Lightweight Galilean loupes perfect for general dentistry and examinations

data.primary: The Galilean 2.5x offers an excellent entry point into magnification. The simple optical design provides a wide field of view and excellent depth of field.
data.secondary: Perfect for general examinations, hygiene procedures, and practitioners new to magnification. Ultra-lightweight design reduces neck strain. Available in multiple frame styles.

name: Galilean 2.7x Loupe
description: Popular mid-range Galilean loupe with excellent balance of magnification and comfort

data.primary: The Galilean 2.7x offers a step up in magnification while maintaining the lightweight comfort of Galilean optics. Ideal for practitioners seeking slightly more detail.
data.secondary: The most popular magnification choice among general practitioners. Provides excellent balance between magnification power and field of view.

name: Galilean 3.2x Loupe
description: Maximum magnification Galilean loupe for enhanced detail visualization

data.primary: The Galilean 3.2x provides the maximum magnification achievable with Galilean optics while maintaining their characteristic lightweight design.
data.secondary: Ideal for practitioners who need more magnification but prefer the wider field of view and lighter weight of Galilean technology over prismatic loupes.

name: Prismatic Loupe System
description: High-magnification prismatic loupes for precision work requiring exceptional detail

data.secondary: Designed for specialists requiring the highest level of magnification and image quality. Available in multiple magnification levels from 4.0x to 6.0x.

name: Salli Ultra Triple Fit
description: Premium ergonomic saddle chair with movable armrests and stretching support. Ideal for dentists, ultrasound rooms, and long clinical procedures.

data.primary: The Salli Ultra Triple Fit is the ultimate ergonomic saddle chair for healthcare professionals. Featuring movable armrests and stretching support, it's designed for dentists, ultrasound rooms, and long clinical procedures. Can also be used as a rehabilitation aid after shoulder injuries.
data.secondary: Easy, precise seat adjustment with pedal control for ergonomic comfort. Width adjustment and tilt mechanism ensure perfect positioning. Premium 100% genuine leather upholstery in your choice of colors.

name: Salli Triple Fit
description: Ergonomic saddle chair with tilt mechanism for perfect sitting angle and healthy spine posture.

data.primary: The Salli Triple Fit features a tilt mechanism that allows the seat to be set to the perfect sitting angle whenever needed. Tilting the seat allows the pelvis to rotate forward, making it easier to reach forward while maintaining a healthy spine posture.
data.secondary: Width adjustment ensures a personalized fit, while the split saddle design promotes healthy sitting. Premium 100% genuine leather upholstery provides comfort and durability.

name: Salli Chin Tilt
description: Ergonomic saddle chair with tilt function to maintain natural upright posture and prevent chin-forward position.

data.primary: The Salli Chin Tilt features a tilt function that helps maintain a natural upright posture, preventing the common chin-forward position caused by leaning. The split saddle design with pressure-relieving central gap frees the tailbone and promotes an open pelvic angle for healthier sitting.
data.secondary: Designed for professionals who spend long hours seated. Premium 100% genuine leather upholstery in five color options.

name: Salli Sway Fit
description: Dynamic saddle chair with swing mechanism supporting natural body movement to reduce strain during long clinical hours.

data.primary: The Salli Sway Fit supports natural body movement, helping reduce strain and improving posture during long clinical hours. Its flexible swing mechanism adapts to your sitting style, offering balanced comfort and stability throughout the day.
data.secondary: Width adjustment ensures personalized comfort. Premium 100% genuine leather upholstery provides durability and easy cleaning.

name: Salli Light
description: Lightweight and mobile saddle chair designed for easy movement between rooms with natural spine alignment.

data.primary: The Salli Light is designed for easy mobility, making it convenient for clinics, workshops, and multi-room use. The saddle design promotes natural spine alignment, reducing back strain and improving long-term comfort.
data.secondary: An affordable entry point to ergonomic saddle sitting. Artificial leather upholstery for easy cleaning and maintenance.
